test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 12 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**drastically**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**drastically**'.
 
• It means 'in a way that is likely to have a strong or far-reaching effect (एक तरह से जो एक मजबूत या दूरगामी प्रभाव होने की संभावना है)'.
